subject: Exec approval: Acme AI — bundled Pro Services + premium support (non-standard terms)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Exec approval for Acme AI Pro Services bundle (premium support included)

Hi team,

Quick context: Acme AI (Samantha + Ben) verbally committed to a 12-month Redwood subscription at $150k ARR and have asked us to include premium support (24/7) + a dedicated onboarding engineer for a 6-week integration sprint. They are pushing for a single SOW that bundles product subscription + pro services + the premium support add-on.

Proposal we delivered: attached Redwood_ProServices_SOW_v2.pdf and Redwood_Quote_Acme_2026-03-08.pdf. Commercial asks from customer:
- Include premium support (24/7) as part of the contract (no separate invoice)
- Dedicated onboarding engineer + custom integration work estimated 6 weeks
- Asking for a 20% discount on professional services line to reach budget target

Impact / risk summary:
- Services margin will compress if we grant 20% off; however, net ARR from product subscription is high and this is a strategic vertical for us.
- Premium support being included at no additional recurring charge is a non-standard concession for Redwood.Hosting this in the same contract affects SLA and escalation commitments.

Ask: I need executive approval to: (1) accept bundling premium support into the subscription, (2) apply up to 20% discount on pro services line and approve the SOW, and (3) allow legal to accept a limited set of non-standard terms in the SOW for custom integration.

Goal: get sign-off today so we can return countersigned SOW with DocuSign by EOB Weds.

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_ProServices_SOW_v2.pdf, Redwood_Quote_Acme_2026-03-08.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: Exec approval for Acme AI Pro Services bundle (premium support included)

Folks — forwarding the request from Aditya. TL;DR: Acme wants premium support and a 6-week onboarding engineer included in the main contract; AE asking for up to 20% discount on services.

Why I’m escalating:
- This is a relatively large logo in our target vertical and they will be a reference.
- The concession is non-standard (embedded premium support + deep integration work).
- We need legal and finance comfort on exposure and margin before we commit.

Decision points we need from you:
1) Legal: major redlines to liability / SLA that would be unacceptable?
2) Finance: acceptable discount cap and revenue recognition considerations?
3) Exec (Vivek): are we comfortable approving this non-standard bundle for strategic reasons?

If we can align by EOD today we can keep the momentum. I’ve attached the original SOW for reference.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole, Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Exec approval for Acme AI Pro Services bundle (premium support included)

Marissa — thanks for the context. I reviewed the SOW. High-level legal concerns:
- SLA: embedding 24/7 premium support in the subscription without clear incident response SLAs and remedies increases legal exposure. Suggest we define response tiers, mean time to respond (MTTR) targets, and a service credit cap tied to the services line, not product revenue.
- Liability / Indemnity: custom integration work expands our integration surface. We should cap liability for pro services to fees paid for the services, and ensure IP warranty language is limited.
- Acceptance criteria: we need clearer milestone-based acceptance for the integration work. The SOW currently says "deliverable: integration" — too vague.

I attached a redline (redlined_sow_v1.docx) with suggested edits: clarify support hours, incident priority definitions, and include an explicit payment/milestone schedule.

If leadership is comfortable, legal can accept a 15% max discount on services with the above redlines; anything more will require senior legal sign-off and possibly an indemnity reservation.

-MK
Markus Klein — Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Exec approval for Acme AI Pro Services bundle (premium support included)

Markus — thanks, appreciate the redlines. A few clarifications from the CS/implementation side to help shape the SOW:
- Custom integration scope (high-level):
  * SAML SSO configuration + testing with their identity provider
  * API adapters for their ingestion pipeline (up to 3 endpoints)
  * Two custom prompt-tuning sessions and a migration assist for 2 existing services
- Onboarding plan: 6-week full-time engagement with a named onboarding engineer for the first 4 weeks, then part-time wrap-up weeks 5–6. We can define milestones (kickoff, API delivery, UAT, production cutover).
- Support: customer requires 24/7 coverage for Sev1, business hours for Sev2/3. We should scope a designated pager rotation and escalation to our on-call.

Financial note: the implementation estimate (labor) is $90k. If we permit 20% discount on that, it reduces services revenue to $72k. Given legal's ask to cap liability and require milestone acceptance, we should ensure milestone payments align with work.

I attached an implementation plan spreadsheet with milestones and estimated hours (ImplementationPlan_Acme.xlsx). If leadership approves the 15% discount Markus proposed, I think we can still get the deal done and retain reasonable margin.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes, Senior Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Exec approval for Acme AI Pro Services bundle (premium support included)

Reviewed numbers and legal considerations. Finance position:
- We can approve up to a 10% discount on recurring subscription fees (product) as long as ARR remains at or above $135k.
- For professional services (one-time implementation), we can approve a discount up to 100% of the services fees but only if we include a capped services credit (no unlimited liability) and milestone-based payments. Practically, this means we can subsidize the services cost to secure the subscription, but we must protect revenue recognition and cash collection through payment schedule and acceptance criteria.
- If Sales is asking to go beyond the 10% product + effectively waive >15% of services margin (i.e., bring total concession impact >15% of deal economics), I need Vivek's explicit approval.

Please see a simple delta:
- Proposed by AE: 20% discount on services + include premium support at no charge.
- Legal suggests: cap discount on services at 15% + redlines on SLA and liability.
- Finance comfortable: 10% product discount + subsidize services (with contractual protections).

Action: Vivek — we need a confirmation on final discount cap (product + services) and permission to include premium support in the contract.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor — Head of Finance Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Exec approval for Acme AI Pro Services bundle (premium support included)

Thanks everyone for the fast turn. After weighing strategic value vs. margin hit, I approve the following non-standard concessions for Acme AI (DEAL-4712):
1) Include premium 24/7 support as part of the subscription for the initial 12-month contract term. Support SLAs must mirror the redlines Markus proposed (incident priority tiers, MTTR, credits capped to services fees).
2) Approve a combined maximum concession of 15% applied across the services line (implementation) and product discounting. Practically: up to 10% product discount + up to 15% services discount OR 0% product + up to 15% services, but total financial impact should not exceed the equivalent of 15% margin concession on the deal value.
3) Require milestone-based acceptance and payment schedule in SOW. Legal to include the liability cap tied to fees paid for services.

Marissa / Aditya: proceed to incorporate Markus' redlines, Rafael's implementation milestones, and Neha's payment schedule. Once redlines are in, send the final SOW via DocuSign. Per my note — keep a copy of the acceptance criteria and have CS own sign-off gates (UAT acceptance).

Proceed to signature today. DocuSign link below for the final envelope.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/Sign/abc123-acme
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4712

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni — Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
